The introduction is already stale: Fleet 4.93.0 shipped on October 8 (`CHANGELOG.md:1`), so there are no longer “two more releases” merely planned for October. Update the newsletter source to reflect that 4.93.0 is available, then regenerate this template so recipients do not receive an inaccurate release status.

This issue also appears on line 28 of the same file.

The PR description is freeform and omits the required template sections, including the `## AI` section with the tool and model ID. Replace it with the repository PR template and fill in the applicable fields before merge.

### 🟡 Changes recommended The email lists the already-released Fleet 4.93.0 as planned, and the PR description omits required sections.
